product_metadata.title: OrganizerLogic Burlap Storage Organizer Basket - Heavy Duty Storage Basket - Perfect Storage Jute Basket for Laundry, Shoes and Kids Toys - 17" x 13" x 13"
features: STAY ORGANIZED: Keep your kitchen, bedroom, and laundry organized with jute baskets. 17”L x 13”W x 10”H large baskets help organize snacks, shoes, crafts, kids toys, dog toys, and laundry.
REDUCE CLUTTER: Fabric storage bins make organizing easy and keep your belongings out of sight. Store pillows, blankets, linen, games, and books.
EASY TO CARRY: Lightweight jute storage bins with reinforced burlap handles allow you to carry your load easier. Wire-rimmed edges add form and stability. Wipes clean.
KEEP YOUR ITEMS CLEAN AND DIRT OUT: Waterproof plastic liner keeps dirt out and inner items clean and dry. Excellent for closets, playroom, nursery, and groceries in the car.
EASY ACCESS: Open top keeps your belongings organized and accessible Collapsible baskets allow you to store them easily when not in use. Folds to 2" height.
